title: arrayDatastore
summary: Create an array datastore descriptor object.
description: `arrayDatastore(A)` creates a descriptor object with `Data` and `ReadSize` properties.
behaviors: The constructor preserves the input data and `ReadSize` metadata for code that passes datastore descriptors around.
Iterator-style operations such as `read`, `hasdata`, and `reset` require the generic datastore dispatch layer and are not provided by this constructor builtin.
